summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Tickets Tab sub-tabs: Add-ons, Promo Codes, and Settings. All 30 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI fully functional with all CRUD operations working correctly for Add-ons and Promo Codes. Settings sub-tab displays all 6 sections with working toggles.
critical_code_review_comments: All Add-ons APIs properly implemented with validation (name required, price >= 0)
All Promo Codes APIs properly implemented with validation (code required, discount_type must be percentage/fixed, percentage <= 100, discount_value > 0)
Event Settings API properly handles all 18 settings fields with proper type conversion
Frontend correctly displays all sub-tabs: Ticket Inventory, Add-ons, Promo Codes, Settings
Add-on dialog has all required fields: name, description, type, price, quantity limit, per order limit, active toggle
Promo Code dialog has Generate button for random code generation
Settings sub-tab has all 6 sections: Tax & Fees, Refund Policy, Ticket Sales Rules, Visibility Rules, Capacity Rules, Confirmation & Invoices
Toggle status functionality works for both Add-ons and Promo Codes
Copy to clipboard functionality works for promo codes
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up during testing. Event ID 1 has 1 add-on (Event T-Shirt) and 1 promo code (EARLYBIRD20)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tickets Tab sub-tabs fully functional. Add-ons CRUD: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/events/:eventId/addons + toggle status. Promo Codes CRUD: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/events/:eventId/promo-codes + toggle status. Settings: GET/PUT /api/events/:eventId/settings with 18 configurable fields across 6 sections.

get_list.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/promo-codes returns list of non-deleted promo codes

create_percentage.details: POST creates percentage discount promo code

create_fixed.details: POST creates fixed amount discount promo code

validation.details: Validates code required, discount_type, percentage <= 100, value > 0

get_by_id.details: GET /api/events/:eventId/promo-codes/:promoId returns single promo, 404 for not found
